# Callout Reference

All five alert types, each carrying a tinted background in both light and
dark themes (previously they had only a colored left border and title).

> [!NOTE]
> Accent blue tint. Useful information that shouldn't be skipped.

> [!TIP]
> Success green tint. Helpful advice, shortcuts, better ways to do things.

> [!IMPORTANT]
> Purple tint. Information the reader should really not miss.

> [!WARNING]
> Amber tint. Caution about potential pitfalls or surprises.

> [!CAUTION]
> Red tint. Strong warning about destructive or irreversible actions.

## Dark Mode

Switch the OS to dark mode (or use devtools to emulate `prefers-color-scheme:
dark`) — each callout switches to its dark-palette tint. This page pairs with
the front matter demo above it: a `title` key sets the tab title while the
callouts show the tint work.
